profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & MSW Student
profile.summary: I'm a senior-level software engineer focused on empowering teams to produce quality code through strong technical leadership, relationship-building, and promotion of positive cultural change. I'm currently only interested in public sector, non-profit, and mission-driven organizations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Consulting, custom websites, and custom web applications built in Javascript, C#, Ruby, and Python.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · PHP · Microservices · TypeScript · WordPress

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Guided operations and maintenance team prioritization in security, standardization, and efficiency in a shifting business landscape.
- Leveraged Datadog to pinpoint and resolve performance issues in a Ruby on Rails application’s use of Sidekiq and Redis, improving system performance at peak hours by 30%.
- Lead modernization of a Laravel application’s branching and release strategy, lowering engineer cognitive load, speeding up time to release, and improving overall system and deploy stability.
- Improved security posture and ecosystem efficiency by removing deprecated applications, replacing abandoned dependencies, removing more than 1.8 million lines of old code, and implementing standard and reusable modules.
- Consolidated redundant configurations by standardizing CI/CD pipelines, speeding up deployments and time to release.
- Extracted API client library from redundant implementations across client React applications to lower start-up costs for new client apps.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · PHP · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · SEIM · Apigee API Management · Microservices · System Architecture · Node.js · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Datadog · Redis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer IV, Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Lead teams through an organization-wide replatforming effort to modernize and scale provider operations; build and architect complex stacks using FHIR, TypeScript, React, and Node; and leverage Google Pub/Sub, Apigee, and other technologies in an Agile Scrum environment.
- Focus on ensuring team delivers high value releases predictably while minimizing defects, regressions, and other production issues.
- Work with Scrum Masters, QA, Product, Design, Engineering Management, Enterprise Architects, and other stakeholders to create requirements, address provider pain points, and balance added business value with cost of development and ownership.
- Coach and mentor software engineers on code quality, sound architecture, and social skills like context-aware communication, proactive ownership, and personal change management.
- Identify areas of improvement to reduce risk and cost of ownership and improve security and performance.
- Provide input on team and organization process management, maturation, and optimization, as a result of sprint retro ceremonies and other venues.
- Ability to quickly pivot to new domains rapidly, building subject-matter expertise and knowledge of existing code bases.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · PHP · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · SEIM · Apigee API Management · Microservices · System Architecture · Scrum · Node.js · React.js · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Act as Interim Technical Manager since March 2021 while the position is being backfilled. Manage a team of 6 direct reports while picking up execution of long-term projects, running sprints, and representing the team to internal and external stakeholders.
- Lead team through high-level systems and feature design while being mindful of antipatterns and strategizing elimination of tech debt.
- Plan and execute the migration of legacy systems to cloud-native solutions while minimizing impact on end users.
- Serve as a resource, advocate, and mentor for other team members, protecting their time, unblocking their work, and reviewing code.
- Work with leadership and stakeholders to develop timelines, forecast accurate deadlines, and prioritize sprint work.
- Communicate with internal and external users at all levels of technical competency to establish requirements and share knowledge.
- Champion team values by researching and writing a group values statement and hiring guide for engineers using anti-racist principles and seeking input from external DEI groups.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Identify, establish, and champion best practices for automated testing, documentation, and logging.
- Document legacy SAS and Java tools while refactoring them into Python.
- Migrate critical systems to AWS while ensuring scalability, security, and fault monitoring.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full-stack development spanning front-end, middleware, data models, APIs, integrations, process automation, and unit testing (including TDD) in an Agile deployment cycle.
- Microsoft ecosystem, including ASP.NET MVC, .NET Core, Azure infrastructure, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, and Git.
- Front-end technologies include React, AngularJS, Webpack, Browserify, ECMAScript, npm, and SASS.
- Design systems and software features by partnering directly with product owners on understanding organizational and customer needs.
- Participate in following coding standards, doing code reviews, and improving deployment strategies.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
- Sole-proprietorship created for freelance consulting.
- Primarily focus on developing custom sites using content management systems like WordPress, MODX, and Shopify.
- Manage and maintain client websites, from pre-design to post-launch.
- Often subcontract for other web agencies and firms.
- Manage client infrastructure, responding to incidents, outages, and configuration issues.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Implement standards compliant ecommerce websites using ASP.NET web controls, HTML, JavaScript, CSS and other technologies
- Analyze and provide feedback to project managers on design concepts focusing on feasibility, usability, data integration and maintenance
- Develop reusable, maintainable, scalable solutions to complex data and content display requirements
- Provide concise documentation on usage and maintenance of custom solutions
- Provide level of effort estimates for non-standard work requested by merchant customers
- Troubleshoot issues that shoppers may encounter when interacting with our ecommerce applications
- Isolate and define clear, accurate problem statements and escalate to the appropriate internal resource if needed
- Research and provide informed opinions on third-party controls and plug-ins

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Implemented website designs with great attention to detail while maintaining scalability and cross-browser compatibility.  Assisted in development of in-house content management system, as well as development of CMS modules and customization.  Managed own projects and clientele without the help of a project manager while providing technical support, debugging services, and maintenance requests.

positions.title: Database Administration Co-op
positions.description: Quickly and accurately handled database access requests and database restores.  Performed upgrades, patching, research, and reporting within MS SQL Server 2005, Oracle 10g, Informix, and mainframe environments.  Assisted with migration process from Informix to SQL Server and Oracle.

positions.title: Information Systems Co-op
positions.description: Designed, developed, and implemented sections of the Intranet and other Web applications including a complex employee time-tracking system using MS Visual Studio 2003 and 2005, ASP.NET, C#, and Crystal Reports 9 and 10.  Designed backing databases (MS SQL Server 2000) and wrote stored procedures in SQL.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assist with email vendor migration, as well as event planning and serving as a Notary Public for public events assisting transgender people with name and gender marker identity document changes.
I facilitate peer-led support groups for transgender and gender non-conforming people.
